test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which sodium salt of glutamic acid is commonly added to Chinese food, canned vegetables, soups and processed meats to enhance the flavour?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Monosodium Glutamate**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Monosodium glutamate,** usually known as sodium glutamate, is the sodium salt of glutamic acid.
 
• MSG in this glutamic acid form is naturally found in various foods, including tomatoes and cheese.
 
• **Monosodium glutamate (MSG) is a flavour enhancer **that is commonly used in restaurant dishes, canned vegetables, soups, deli meats, and other foods.
 
• **MSG** has been designated as a generally recognised safe food additive by the** United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium carbonate, Na2CO3,** is an inorganic chemical having the formula Na2CO3 and its many hydrates. All forms are white, **odourless, water-soluble salts** that produce mildly alkaline solutions in water.
 
• **Gloxazone **is a tick-borne illness treatment. It was discovered **to be harmful to rats' kidneys.**
